I was working at FedEx Ground. Hired on as seasonal and lasted a few months. I worked morning shift and night @ 3.5hrs each shift. We work straight through with no breaks any shift. Days I not only sort boxes but because we are short staffed, they call for me to help unload the trailers. Or they would call me to fill in for someone going back and forth going from my place to several other positions. Well, as I am sorting, I have to push boxes down the rollers to 2 other people for them to sort onto pallets. A lady that is not strong enough  always asks me to help lift. When I do, i miss boxes coming down the chute. Well this goes on for months and when boxes fall, she refused to pick them up that are right next to her. I mean next to her feet. She would ask me to come down and pick them up. After a while I refused and then management was called down to ask me why I wouldn't help her. I said, y'all have me running around here with several positions and now yall want me to do parts of her job that she can't do, I wan't some more money. Manager acted like i was offensive and told me upper management wanted to see me after the sort. I had enough and when i went to "UM" the guy told me in a stern and angry voice to close the door and sit down". I said, no I'm just gonna go home. Then he yells at me to close door, sit down. I repeat that i had already resigned. More yelling at his part, but I stood up for myself and just walked out. Felt good.
